name: SmartCity Forma — SIH26114 Sustainable Urban Site Planning & Analysis
description: Smart City Site Planning and Analysis using Autodesk Forma and Revit BIM for Smart India Hackathon SIH26114. Features minimum 1 km² site design, Proposal A vs B comparison via Forma Board, 8 environmental analyses, Revit office tower BIM synchronization, 30-second walkthrough, and 7-slide competition pitch deck.
